_comment: A deep cavalry squadron breaks while still locked in a melee and its men flee through the enemy's ranks without riding through each other (#1785). A brittle player squadron (48 mounts at morale 0.5) stands on open ground facing north-west (-135 degrees); an enemy cavalry squadron (80 mounts) 230 wu up that line charges it on its own (no player input). The charge carries the enemy's open files right through the player squadron, so from about tick 190 the two blocks stand interleaved, the player's men in diagonal ranks among the enemy's. The player squadron routs at tick 309 on the clip's seed (FIGHTING at 308, ROUTING at 309), still in contact. Each routed man then runs on his own from the enemy he sees toward his own back edge (SoldierFlightStep), out through the enemy's ranks, and the enemy squadron rides after the runners man by man (SoldierPursuitStep). Measured with dense 2-tick FULL dumps on seeds 0 to 4, 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch: no two of the squadron's men stand within a body radius of each other at ticks 310, 350, 400, 450 and 500 (pairs_within_body_radius 0, pinned), the men's centroid runs north from about (880, 880) at the rout to (931.4 to 991.8, 582.2 to 603.2) at tick 660, and every seed is out of the enemy's reach by tick 600 (pinned). The slots_across_centreline pins of 0 at ticks 310 to 500 measured the slot grid's swing under the men in #1785's flight; the bottom-up flight (#1949) removed that grid (a routed man has no slot), so they are retired for the pairs_within_body_radius pins, which fail for a rout that sends men through each other, and the contact pin, which fails for one that stays in the melee. Ticks 308 and 309 sit on the clip's seed: on 2 of seeds 1 to 4 the squadron breaks a tick or two earlier, on main as here. The squadron is still fleeing north when the clip ends at tick 660, before it rallies.

overlap.reason: overlap reads uid1 (the enemy squadron riding the runners down) 4.71 against 5.0 on seed 3 at tick 616 while it pursues, two riders converging on one runner; seeds 0, 1, 2 and 4 pass (dense 2-tick FULL dumps, measured 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch). Each pursuing rider gives way to a friend he touches (SoldierKeepClear), but not always fast enough when several close on one runner. Body-to-body avoidance between a unit's own men is #1974.
